title: Real controller focus ring on Steam-style/Spotlight's card grids
description: Closes the actual disclosed gap: Steam-style's poster grid and Spotlight's 'Also In Your Collection' section never showed a focus ring at all, even though the D-pad state tracking it needed was already correct - just never passed through. Wires focusedID from GameModeView into both LibrarySteamStyleLayout and LibrarySpotlightLayout, which pass it straight to their own SkinWebGridFragmentView. Id-matching (not position) means it stays correct even though both views render a *filtered* subset of the full library. Not yet confirmed live with real controller hardware - see notes.md.
commit_message: Wire focusedID through Steam-style/Spotlight's card grids
